verdict.rationale: Klaviyo ships an official MCP server and says its public APIs and MCP let AI agents "read, write, and act on Klaviyo data" headlessly. Its Composer AI "builds the audience" from a stated goal, but that is described as an in-app feature, not a programmatic surface. The documented MCP examples cover campaign creation and flow reports, not segment creation, so the agent-to-real-segment path is only implied. Missing for 10: an explicit segment-creation API endpoint or MCP tool, documentation of an agent turning natural-language audience criteria into segment definitions, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
